meta.name: mem-setup
meta.description: This skill should be used when the user asks to "set up claude-mem", "pair claude-mem", "connect cmem", "add my cmem key", "set up cloud sync in Cowork", or provides cmem.ai Connect values (sync token, user id, SyncHub URL) for this plugin. Configures the claude-mem-cowork plugin credentials.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 输入 cmem 连接信息,完成 claude-mem 凭证配置
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要为 claude-mem 插件配置连接凭证
copy.tagline_en: Enter cmem connection details and complete the claude-mem credential setup.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to configure claude-mem plugin credentials.

howto.what: 装好后,Claude 会引导你把 cmem.ai 的三个凭据(sync token、user id、SyncHub URL)写进插件 config.json,让 hooks 能捕获并注入记忆;若在 Cowork 容器里,会告诉你重新打包才能让配对永久保留。
howto.when: 当你要求「set up claude-mem」「connect cmem」等关键词,或直接粘贴 cmem.ai Connect 里的凭据时接管。

say.text: 帮我设置 claude-mem,凭据我这就贴给你
say.note: 它会从粘贴内容里提取三个值写入配置

say.text: 这是我的 cmem sync token,帮我配上云同步
say.note: token 不会回显,只经文件写入

say.text: 检查一下 claude-mem 的配对状态
say.note: 运行 status 并回报脱敏输出

howto.what_en: Claude writes your three cmem.ai credentials (sync token, user id, SyncHub URL) into the plugin config.json so hooks capture and inject memory. Cowork containers are ephemeral, so it notes you must repackage to keep the pairing.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to "set up claude-mem", "connect cmem", or paste cmem.ai Connect values for this plugin.

say_en.text: Set up claude-mem for me; here are my credentials
say_en.note: Extracts the three values from what you paste

say_en.text: Add my cmem sync token to the plugin config
say_en.note: The token is never echoed back
Runs status and reports masked output
